title: In a UK online safety consultation, the US urges the UK against an under-16 social media ban, saying it would place a "disproportionate" burden on US Big Tech (Dan Milmo/The Guardian)
summary: Dan Milmo / The Guardian: In a UK online safety consultation, the US urges the UK against an under-16 social media ban, saying it would place a “disproportionate” burden on US Big Tech — Trump administration says restrictions could impose ‘disproportionate’ burden on US tech companies
contentText:
Dan Milmo / The Guardian :

In a UK online safety consultation, the US urges the UK against an under-16 social media ban, saying it would place a “disproportionate” burden on US Big Tech   —  Trump administration says restrictions could impose ‘disproportionate’ burden on US tech companies
